card.line: Timnah was a town of Judah, later held by the Philistines, and sources name two towns called Timnah, one tied to Samson's wife.

moments.title: Judah heads to Timnah
moments.text: After his wife died, Judah went up to Timnah to his sheepshearers. Tamar sat at Enaim, on the way to Timnah, to meet him. The sources do not say which Timnah this was.

moments.title: Samson wants a wife
moments.text: Samson went down to Timnah and saw a young Philistine woman. He told his parents to get her for him as a wife.

moments.title: The lion in the vineyards
moments.text: On the way to Timnah, a young lion came roaring at Samson in the vineyards. The Spirit of the LORD came powerfully on him, and he tore the lion apart with his bare hands.

moments.title: The Philistines take Timnah
moments.text: In the days of King Ahaz, the Philistines raided the cities of Judah and took Timnah and its villages. The LORD humbled Judah because Ahaz had been most unfaithful to Him.
